limitations.detail: MEM exact-row lookup has 0 test hits across all 20 MEM environment/seed cells; test utility uses the frozen global-majority fallback.
RAW C_total=0 because raw input storage and the common downstream task head are excluded by the frozen accounting.
H1 evidence supports claims only relative to the frozen exact-row MEM comparator under ENV-1..ENV-4 and the five frozen seeds.
The evidence does not establish learned-representation superiority to RAW; negative RAW utility deltas are retained.
L3 remains IRM-style surrogate and L4 remains adapted DANN exactly as frozen in EXP-LRN-001.
